question: Should bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets proceed after the dashboard substrate lands, and which log-stream, redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-output boundaries must they follow?
rationale: The request is plausible but exposes operational logs and command output through a new dashboard surface, and the current related stream-binding PR deliberately leaves command execution/output as separate security-sensitive work.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Stream Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and implement only after Wave 1 dashboard and the approved log-stream or stream-binding contract are accepted.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Data
options.body: Allow a smaller feature that uses only existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution or generic command bindings.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context until maintainers decide whether these widgets belong in bundled OpenClaw or an external plugin path.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Stream Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and implement only after Wave 1 dashboard and the approved log-stream or stream-binding contract are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main owner signal for the existing log-tail and plugin-tab surfaces that this feature would build on.
